reports.title: Automated QA test report
reports.description: This is a test description from the QA script.

reports.title: Airport taxi quoted Rs 1,000 to Lakeside
reports.description: Meter would have been ~Rs 300. InDrive showed Rs 350. Walk past the kerbside cluster or pre-book via your guesthouse.

reports.title: Thamel to Bhaktapur taxi fare check
reports.description: Driver wanted Rs 2,800 for a one-way trip; fair range is Rs 1,300–1,700. Agree the price before boarding.

reports.title: Park entry fee confirmation
reports.description: Foreigner day pass confirmed at Rs 1,500 at the gate; keep the ticket for jeep bookings.

reports.title: Fake guide without licence near Lakeside
reports.description: A man near the tourist bus stop claimed to be a trekking guide but had no TAAN/NTIA card. Ask for the licence and check the photo.

reports.title: Unlicensed 'mountain guide' at airport
reports.description: Offered a cheap EBC package but refused to show any certification. Use a registered trekking agency only.

reports.title: Taxi meter overcharge near airport
reports.description: Taxi from TIA to Thamel quoted Rs 2,500. Use the prepaid taxi counter inside arrivals instead.

reports.title: Unwanted attention in Lakeside night market
reports.description: Group of men followed a solo traveler near Lakeside around 11pm. Avoid empty side streets after dark and use app taxis.

reports.title: Road blocked by landslide near Kagbeni
reports.description: Check with locals before driving the Kagbeni stretch after heavy rain. Shared jeeps are being re-routed.

reports.title: Fake safari operator in Sauraha
reports.description: Someone posing as a national park guide sells overpriced 'VIP safaris'. Book only through registered lodges.

reports.title: Pickpocketing in Thamel crowd
reports.description: Phone taken in the evening crowd on the main Thamel street. Keep valuables in a front pocket.

reports.title: Gautam Buddha airport has no international flights yet
reports.description: Bhairahawa's international airport is underutilised — fly or bus via Kathmandu instead of expecting direct routes.
